title: NPC Roster and Recurring Characters
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=npc:ledger
| stats count as appearances, latest(status) as status, latest(_time) as last_seen by npc
| where status="alive"
| sort - appearances
description: Keeps a roster of the non-player characters the party has met, tracking who recurs and who is still alive.
value: A living NPC ledger helps a game master keep continuity and bring back characters the players remember.
implementation: Ingest NPC ledger entries into `index=personal`; track appearances and status per NPC.
visualization: Table of NPCs by appearances and status.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a list of the characters the group has met, tracking who keeps coming back into the story.
